summary: Liberty Global Ltd. filed an 8-K announcing its board authorized management to repurchase Class A and Class C common shares from time to time based on market conditions and capital allocation priorities. The company anticipates no more than $200 million in selective repurchases over any twelve-month period; the board may authorize additional programs later. Repurchases may occur via open market purchases, privately negotiated transactions, block trades, or other methods, potentially under Rule 10b5-1 plans and Rule 10b-18. This is a routine capital return initiative with no fixed price, premium, or timing. Watch for actual repurchase execution and any future expanded authorizations.
